siteSettings.siteName: Antonio Riyanto | Senior Creative Designer Portfolio
siteSettings.seoTitle: Antonio Riyanto — Senior Creative Designer & Brand Architect
siteSettings.seoDescription: Portfolio & Content Management System of Antonio Riyanto, Senior Creative Designer based in Jakarta, Indonesia specializing in print, digital media, packaging, and motion graphics.

profile.headline: 6 Years of Visual Architecture.
profile.heroDescription: Based in Jakarta. I specialize in high-stakes brand management and full-scale creative production. From managing global brand identities to developing web interfaces and motion assets, I deliver precise visual solutions that drive engagement.
profile.about: For 6 years, I've bridged the gap between physical print and digital media. I specialize in high-stakes brand management and full-scale creative production, ensuring that every visual solution drives true engagement. Based in Jakarta, working globally. I don't just design; I supervise the entire lifecycle from the first pixel to the final print.

experiences.summary: Design and develop marketing communication materials for offline and online platforms. Manage end-to-end design process for print production including POP displays, hoardings, packaging, and brand guidelines.
Researched content for brand campaigns, created design content, images, motion graphics, and videos for social media. Designed print collateral and developed the company website using HTML/CSS.
Discussed with clients to determine branding and marketing goals. Collaborated with the creative team to build social strategies and execute design needs.
Collaborated with Creative Team for insightful visual content. Worked with Art Director to determine brand identity designs and handled 20+ client company accounts.
Collaborated with interns to create monthly content plans for Instagram, wrote copywriting, and executed social media assets.

education.description: Focused on visual communication design, print production, branding, and interactive digital arts.
Completed secondary education with focus on social sciences and humanities.

projects.shortDescription: Developing Key Visuals, marketing communication materials, and overseeing end-to-end production for retail displays.
projects.challenge: Coordinating nationwide retail store brand guidelines with high-precision print production requirements.
projects.solution: Created standardized packaging, POP displays, hoardings, and promotional assets ensuring strict brand consistency.

projects.shortDescription: Researching and creating comprehensive design content, motion graphics, and developing the company website.
projects.challenge: Building daily social media engagement and creating a user-friendly corporate website.
projects.solution: Designed high-impact graphics and coded responsive company web interface using HTML and CSS.

projects.shortDescription: Collaborating with clients to define corporate branding goals and executing cross-platform visual strategies.
projects.challenge: Translating diverse client visions into cohesive brand identities and marketing collateral.
projects.solution: Formulated robust social strategies and designed bespoke print and digital assets.

projects.shortDescription: Executing monthly content plans and daily social media design for 20+ client companies under PT Mindo.
projects.challenge: Managing high-volume daily content creation across 20 distinct client brand identities with fast turnaround times.
projects.solution: Streamlined design production pipelines with Art Director oversight to maintain exceptional visual standard across diverse industries.

projects.projectTitle: Social Media Design & Instagram Grid Feed

projects.challenge: Creating an engaging, clean, and cohesive social media feed that highlights express laundry services and special promotions.
projects.solution: Developed a signature teal-and-white visual grid system featuring service highlights, member discounts, and festive greetings.

projects.projectTitle: Flash Sale & Product Campaign Social Media

projects.challenge: Communicating high-value discounts and technical cleaning equipment benefits clearly through dynamic social media formats.
projects.solution: Leveraged Karcher's iconic yellow brand identity with bold typography and clean product cutouts for maximum conversion.

projects.shortDescription: Daily promotional graphics, markdown price alerts, and festive holiday greetings for Belva supermarket.
projects.challenge: Promoting daily household essentials, price drops, and holiday essentials while maintaining a trustworthy retail brand image.
projects.solution: Designed structured price tag graphics, festive greeting posts for Ramadan/Earth Day, and safety protocol notices.

projects.projectTitle: Home-Cooked Food Delivery App & Web UI

projects.challenge: Introducing a new community-based food ordering platform that connects neighbors with home cooks.
projects.solution: Created vibrant green-themed promotional ads, app mockup showcases, and landing page visuals highlighting fresh homemade dishes.

projects.shortDescription: Reseller recruitment campaigns, product highlights, and engaging social media posts for Toko Salman distributor.
projects.challenge: Attracting milk product resellers and engaging retail customers with interactive educational and financial incentive posts.
projects.solution: Designed eye-catching 'Makin Cuan Jadi Agen' campaigns, recipe highlights, and interactive puzzle posts.

projects.shortDescription: Appetizing fast food promotional posts, combo meal packages, and creative conceptual ads for Dilla Chicken.
projects.challenge: Maximizing appetite appeal and promoting value bundle packages in a competitive fast-food market.
projects.solution: Crafted striking red-themed visual compositions featuring close-up crispy chicken photography, bundle pricing, and witty emergency hunger concepts.

testimonials.quote: Antonio didn't just design a package; he crafted a visual experience that elevated our entire brand identity on the shelves.
The attention to detail in his print production files and motion graphics is simply world-class. A true versatile talent.
A rare hybrid of a print expert and digital motion artist. The campaigns he designed boosted our engagement instantly.
